name: Xi ma
summary: Black-sesame sweet soup, also called chè mè đen: sweet, rich, and cool.
origin: Hội An, on the 16 Apr 2024 city page. Look for Cụ Thiều’s shoulder pole.
taste: Xí mà is sweet, rich, and cool.
where: Hội An. Look for Cụ Thiều’s shoulder pole.
The Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 7 June 2023 market article names xí mà among local gifts and does not add a recipe.
seoTitle: Xi ma — black-sesame sweet soup in Hoi An
seoDescription: Xí mà is Hội An’s black-sesame sweet soup on Da Nang’s 2024 food page. Look for Cụ Thiều’s shoulder pole.
